# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is a large mixed bag of call snippets from Crayon Roofing and Structures (factory at Manali / Andarkuppam check post, Chennai). A genuine sales thread does exist and is reasonably rich — covering inbound enquiries for metal roofing sheets, polycarbonate sheets, PUFF panels, screws, welding rods and MS channels, plus dealer/distributor rate negotiations. However, a very large share of the recordings are NOT sales calls: they are internal Diwali-gift distribution logistics, driver/vehicle coordination, loading/porter/bike-delivery calls, payment-collection follow-ups, bill-copy/outstanding queries, and stray wrong-number calls. These have been excluded. The knowledge base below is built only from the real customer-facing sales conversations — rate enquiries, order placement, objections, and dealer talk. Because the sales content is scattered across many short fragments rather than full structured calls, some patterns (e.g., full negotiation-to-close arcs) are thin; this KB stays close to what is actually said rather than extrapolating.

## Products & brand ladder
Based only on what reps actually quoted/discussed:

- **Metal roofing sheets (core product)** — made in-house at the Manali factory from coil.
  - **JSW Color On Plus** — flagship brand, thickness commonly 0.47 mm (also 0.45, 0.50, 0.60 mm available). Colors: sky blue, off-white/half-white, royal blue, grey/dark green ("Kali Shelt Green").
  - **JSW Pragathi** — a step-up/branded variant, priced higher than Color On Plus.
  - **JSW Radiance / Silver-On** — other JSW-family options mentioned when Color On Plus/Pragathi unavailable or for price comparison.
  - **Asian brand (Indira Dhanush, Asian Force)** — lower-cost alternative line, e.g. "Indra தனுஷ் நேர ஏட்டு... 370+GST" and separately "Asian Force .45 Indira Dhanush 370+ GST."
  - Tile-profile / clay-tile-look profile sheets are **not made in-house** — reps redirect: "நம்ம company-ல இல்ல யார் பண்றா... Amar-ல பண்றாங்களே" [we don't make it, Amar/Everlast make it].
- **PUFF / sandwich panels** (wall + roof) — separate factory line, 50 mm / 40 mm / 30 mm thickness, used for insulated sheds; priced per running meter/square meter, much higher than plain sheet (~₹2000/running meter, ~₹1650+GST/sq m).
- **Polycarbonate sheets (brand: Lexan)** — thickness options 1.5, 1.8, 2 mm (clear/transparent); standard max length 15 feet. 4 mm not stocked — "4 mm-க்கு... நாங்க factory-ல தான் பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்... quantity அதிகமா இருந்தாதான்" [only make-to-order for 4mm if quantity is large].
- **Accessories**: L-flash, cutter (corner pieces), ridge, gutter, barge board, crimp — all custom cut to diagram, priced by configuration (e.g., standard width 610 mm vs oversize 900 mm = different/doubled rate).
- **MS Channels** — JSBL/JSW brand structural channel (125×65 etc.) — handled by a separate contact, reps often hand off: "சார் நான் இன்னொரு நம்பர் contact நம்பர் தரேன்."
- **Screws** — Tata Agri-brand self-drilling screws (various sizes: 1", 2", M8×55 full-thread, 2 inch rust-free), sold by carton/"cotton" of ~₹2000–2500 pack.
- **Welding rods** — Tata brand, sold with periodic dealer schemes/targets (carton-based pricing, volume slabs mentioned: 60/100/300 packet tiers).
- **Products explicitly NOT carried** (reps redirect or decline): GI sheet (plain galvanized, 80/120 GSM), UPVC sheet, liner sheet, MS corrugated 1.2mm, Louvre (price pending from supplier).

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- JSW Color On Plus 0.47 mm: **₹420 + GST / sq m** (one call) and **₹445 + GST / sq m** (another call, same brand/thickness) — rates clearly fluctuate by date/customer.
- JSW Pragathi (branded) 0.47: **₹445 + GST / sq m**.
- 10 ft sheet (metal roofing), JSW Color On Plus 0.47: **₹1466 + 18% GST per sheet**.
- Asian Indradhanush 0.45 mm sheet, 10 ft: **₹1251 + 18% GST + loading charge**.
- Asian/Indira Dhanush coil: quoted around **₹370–410 + GST / sq m**, or **₹97–120/kg + GST** depending on how customer wants it priced (kg vs sq m vs running meter all came up — reps had to convert).
- Running-meter weight reference used for conversion: **0.47 mm sheet ≈ 4 kg per sq m / ~4.2 running-meter weight**.
- Polycarbonate (Lexan), per sq meter: **₹800 + GST** (clear, 2 mm).
- PUFF panel: **₹1650 + GST / sq m**, or quoted as **₹2000/running meter** inclusive-style when customer wants simple running-meter cost.
- Cutter/L-flash accessories: standard width up to 610 mm = **₹655/piece**; if combined width (e.g. 300+300+300=900mm) exceeds standard, **rate roughly doubles** since full sheet width must be used.
- Screws: 2" rust-free Tata = **₹4.66 + tax**; Tata 2" standard = **₹4.44 + tax**; 1" = **₹2.93 + tax**; M8×55 full-thread = **₹4.44+tax (approx, same slab)**.
- 25 mm screw PO correction: **₹2.93 vs ₹3.08** mismatch resolved by phone.
- Welding rod: consumer/dealer price discussed around **₹330–356/packet including tax**, with competitor undercutting at **₹300–330**.
- **Payment terms (quoted explicitly)**: "50% advance payment, balance 50% வந்து delivery-க்கு முன்னாடி பண்ணனும்" [50% advance, 50% before delivery]. For custom/polycarbonate jobs: 50% advance + 50% on delivery, vehicle release only after full payment.
- **GST/billing**: no cash-only billing without GST — "without GST பண்ண முடியாது... with GST தான் full-ஆவே" firmly stated to a customer asking for a GST-free cash bill.
- **Transport/delivery**: delivery vehicle arrangement is the **customer's scope**, not company's — stated repeatedly ("vehicle உங்க scope தான் வரும்", "Freight excluded... transportation your scope").
- Lead times quoted: roofing sheet production ~5–6 days if stock/coil available; "stock கம்மியா இருக்கும், 4-5 days ஆகும்... 1 week ஆகும்" when coil needs to come in first.

## Objection Playbook
- **"Cash bill இல்லாம GST இல்லாம பண்ண முடியுமா?"** [Can you bill without GST, cash only?]
  → Rep: "இல்ல sir, without GST பண்ண முடியாது. with GST தான் full-ஆவே." Firm, no exception given.
- **"Rate ரொம்ப அதிகமா இருக்கு, competitor-கிட்ட கம்மியா கிடைக்குது"** [Rate too high vs competitor]
